explanation: The plan correctly cropped the text-free background before adding wording, so it did not actually wire a finished square ad into a landscape crop. Its main mistake was treating text-overlay as a design-layout tool: a plain text band cannot reliably provide independent typography or the requested two-column landscape composition. The catalogue's misleading warning about image-model text encouraged this choice, and the clipped landscape was delivered without verification.
better_chain: image (qwen-image-2.1: design the complete square ad with all five exact strings, clear hierarchy, leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling) → image-edit (use the square as reference to recompose a complete 9:16 ad, preserving readable copy rather than shrinking it) → image-edit (use the square as reference to recompose a complete 16:9 ad with a landscape-specific layout) → check (verify each variant's aspect, exact copy, address readability, contrast and margins) → image-edit (repair any failed variant and recheck)
